answer: A raven-feathered arrow stops Sybils in the orchard economy. A newcomer fletches 30 arrows over 24 days, and each one gets 3 raven feathers, glued, then flight-tested by 2 fletchers from different workshops and logged on the board. An arrow that veers off target loses its credit and fletching pauses 10 days; 3 veering arrows void the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents means 30,000 arrows, 90,000 feathers and 60,000 flight tests, a wall no forger climbs, while honest work flies true as a mirror held to the sky. Trust comes feather by feather, like an orchard grown one tree at a time.
